allow: PowerShell(Get-Command python, py, node, npx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)

PowerShell($tools = 'magick','inkscape','rsvg-convert','npx','node','dotnet'; foreach \($t in $tools\) { $c = Get-Command $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { "$t -> $\($c.Source\)" } else { "$t -> NOT FOUND" } })
PowerShell(node -e "for \(const m of ['sharp','puppeteer','puppeteer-core','@resvg/resvg-js']\) { try { require.resolve\(m\); console.log\(m+' -> FOUND'\) } catch { console.log\(m+' -> no'\) } }")
